## T4 — per-seat campaign EV(K) = (1-q)^K K x - (1-(1-q)^K) L1 at the credited step (AG-6 + AG-7), MSK

x = P*E - (1-P*)m (a fraud's net if never detected); L1 = m + S4 (what the first detection collects automatically); AG-7 voids every other licence the convicted seat signed, so a campaign through one seat earns only if none of its K claims is detected before maturity.

## T11 — what one deliberate trip of the network breaker costs (lane B), MSK

* K1 escaped-and-convicted event: seat S4 9,602.54 + producer S3 3,250.00 - the escaped E 3,200.85 = 9,651.69 a planted event; at q_measured 0.5 an escape needs ~2 attempts: ~19,303.39; the K1 floor of 3 events: ~57,910.16 a trip
* K2 short collection: a bond convicted past its collateral while its colluding seat's S4 is still collected (the seat side is never short before 13 charges): >= one 13k bond forfeited a trip, and a colluding seat
